title: Claim Inventory Schema
description: Validates a claim_inventory array where each claim tracks factual assertions, their evidence status, and allowed visual treatments. Designed for integration into the canonical storyboard SSOT.

claim_id.description: Stable claim identifier, e.g. C001 or C-sources-3.

source_id.description: Reference into the source research log. Required for source-backed claim types.

claim_text.description: Exact claim text as it appears or is derived from the approved script.

claim_type.description: Categorical type. Types other than opinion/original_argument require source_id.

citation_status.description: source_backed: has at least one supporting source. unsupported_opinion: explicitly marked as opinion. unverified: pending fact-check.

requires_visual_reinforcement.description: If true, the storyboard must include a visual that reinforces this claim.

allowed_visual_treatment.description: The approved creative treatment for visualising this claim in the storyboard.

script_segment_refs.description: Script segment ids where this claim appears or is referenced.

storyboard_entity_refs.description: Storyboard shot or overlay ids that visually represent this claim.
